product.ta-walkstation-386sx.summary: The Walkstation 386SX combined a compact notebook with an expansion dock.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.history: ISER holds a 1991 example and identifies it as equivalent to the Olivetti S20. The dock supported desktop peripherals.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.technical.c: The dock expanded the compact notebook. ISER describes keyboard and mouse ports. Computerwoche distinguishes this A4 notebook from the System SX20 with detachable keyboard.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.technical.v: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.technical.l: The system ROM is preserved and hash-checked. MAME marks the profile as preliminary and two microcontroller firmware dumps are missing.
product.ta-walkstation-386sx.technical.m: Computerwoche · Neue Portables werden in Nürnberg hergestellt · 15 March 1991
